type_notes.scenario_card: A cyan glowing window with a title bar, window icons, a centred objective and key-value rows (type, difficulty, time limit, reward, failure penalty); sets the stakes of a challenge.
type_notes.timer_window: A translucent blue countdown window with large digits, repeated at falling values to show time pressure.
type_notes.hexagon_message: A hexagon outline with spiked tails; red text is a speaking character, glowing blue on navy is channel and constellation traffic.
type_notes.system_window: A translucent blue rectangle with bracketed system text: achievement, reward, understanding and trait notices.
type_notes.skill_card: A blue window naming a skill with a level or level change.
